grasp_model.model: contact-gated exact local no-slip constraint on configured actual Franka hand or finger links

final_metrics.model: local finite-capacity porous-sheet reservoir / split SPH-PBD coupling

cloth_contact_model.model: single-cloth particle shell, scene-local radius override

cloth_config.material_description: plush_cotton PDF reference: 180 g/m2 planar woven-cotton approximation with directional finite-extension limits and physical dihedral bending; not experimentally calibrated.

model.model: PDF-referenced cotton membrane, dihedral bending and local damping

membrane.model: tension-only finite extension of existing woven-cloth mesh edges
membrane.material_axes: original horizontal cloth X=warp, Y=weft; other edges=bias
membrane.solver: inverse-mass-weighted in-place projections on disjoint edge colors
membrane.coupled_constraint_residual: finite sweeps and later bending/contact may exceed bounds; inspect measure()

bending.solver: in-place inverse-mass-weighted Gauss-Seidel on disjoint four-node hinge colors
bending.reference_numerical_difference: Sequential disjoint hinge colors replace source-archive summed Jacobi to suppress fine-grid checkerboard amplification; energy, rigidity, relaxation and iteration count unchanged
bending.multiplier_reset: once per simulation substep by material_response
bending.flat_angle_gradient: finite analytic gradient; atan2 signed angle

mass.model: native uniform dry masses from areal density, unchanged by this adapter

internal_damping.model: degree-normalized axial relative-velocity impulses on disjoint edge colors
internal_damping.scope: free endpoints of this cloth's physical mesh edges

air_drag.area_model: one third of each incident physical rest triangle area
air_drag.scope: free cotton particles only; native force divided by current native mass

linear_drag.integration: v *= exp(-rate*substep_dt), after internal damping and before native forces
linear_drag.scope: free cotton particles only; SPH and rigid bodies unchanged
linear_drag.difference_from_pdf: PDF full-scene drag is intentionally restricted to cotton
